title: pedig — a soft "and, on the other hand"

sections.content: pedig links two clauses with a light contrast — 'and, on the other hand'. Like is, it never opens its clause: most pedig tanulok means 'and now I'm studying', picking up from whatever came before it.

items.spanish: Ma otthon vagyok, most pedig tanulok.
items.english: Today I'm home, and now I'm studying.
At school they usually study too.

sections.content: pedig is softer than de (but) — reach for pedig when you're adding a new angle to the same idea, and de when you're contradicting the previous one.
